cond_0001.intro: As a FedRAMP Cloud Security Analyst you will be responsible for managing the Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) support for Amazon Web Services (AWS) based cloud systems under the DCSA Program Executive Office (PEO), ensuring their security and compliance.
cond_0001.requirements:
Candidates should demonstrate a detailed knowledge the following:
Minimum Requirements
Prior support of FedRAMP activities for cloud hosted systems such as eMASS Package (ex: Readiness Assessment Report (RAR), System Security Plan (SSP), Plan of actions & Milestones (POA&M), etc.)
Review, Audit, and validate compliance of DCSA systems Secure Cloud Computing Architecture (SCCA) to ensure cloud systems connections to the Boundary CAP (BCAP) and Virtual Datacenter Security Stack (VDSS) are implemented in accordance with the cloud Security Requirements Guide (SRG) including support for the internal implementation of the Visual Data Management System (VDMS) solutions internally.
Perform periodic cyber security control assessments of IT cloud systems, identify potential risks and gaps, and make recommendations and implement cloud security improvements based on industry standards and best practices.
Perform Cyber Security Impact Assessments and Risk Assessments for new and existing cloud systems, determine security posture and viability for organizational use, and make recommendations for cloud security architectures and controls.
Provide support for the internal Information Security Continuous Monitoring Program for authorization to operate and ongoing authorization approvals for cloud-based IT systems.
At least two (2) years relevant Cloud Security experience.
Bachelor's Degree, or equivalent experience in Cybersecurity, and/or Information Systems Management, Information Technology.
DoDM 8140/DoDM 8570.01-M IAM Level I requirements prior to onboarding e.g., CAP, CND, Cloud+, GSLC, Security+ CE, HCISPP or higher-level certification.
Active Secret Required and eligibility for TS.
Must speak English well enough to communicate complex technical ideas to a diverse customer both verbally and in written form.
Preferred Requirements
Experience working with Third Party Assessment Organizations (3PAO).
Participation with the DISA Cloud Joint Verification Team (JVT) Team.
Assist the Product Managers (PMs) and/or Program Management Office (PMO) with cyber security audits and assessments of cloud systems including programmatic reviews and management of corrective action plans.
Participated in reviews of Information System Agreement (ISA) / Memorandum of Agreement (MOA), Whitelisting, etc.
Worked with the solution engineers to identify best practices and methods required by the FedRAMP PMO to configure and operate within the NIST SP 800 series of controls.
Assist with non-cloud systems authorization efforts utilizing the Risk Management Framework (RMF).
Understanding and familiarity with cloud architectures (e.g. SaaS, PaaS, IaaS), common commercial cloud systems (e.g. AWS, Microsoft 365, etc.) as well as specific DOD cloud architecture BCAP, ICAP, SCCA, cloud security solutions (e.g. Cloud Access Security Broker, Multi-factor Authentication, Zero Trust Architecture).
Multiple cloud certifications.

Experience with FedRAMP activities for cloud hosted systems such as eMASS Package (e.g., Readiness Assessment Report (RAR), System Security Plan (SSP), Plan of Actions & Milestones (POA&M), etc.)
Review, audit, and validate compliance of DCSA systems Secure Cloud Computing Architecture (SCCA) to ensure cloud systems connections to the Boundary CAP (BCAP) and Virtual Datacenter Security Stack (VDSS) are implemented in accordance with the cloud Security Requirements Guide (SRG), including support for the internal implementation of the Visual Data Management System (VDMS) solutions internally.
Perform periodic cyber security control assessments of IT cloud systems, identify potential risks and gaps, and make recommendations and implement cloud security improvements based on industry standards and best practices.
Perform Cyber Security Impact Assessments and Risk Assessments for new and existing cloud systems, determine security posture and viability for organizational use, and make recommendations for cloud security architectures and controls.
Provide support for the internal Information Security Continuous Monitoring Program for authorization to operate and ongoing authorization approvals for cloud-based IT systems.
Familiarity with working with Third Party Assessment Organizations (3PAO).
Participation with the DISA Cloud Joint Verification Team (JVT) Team.
Assist the Product Managers (PMs) and/or Program Management Office (PMO) with cyber security audits and assessments of cloud systems including programmatic reviews and management of corrective action plans.
Exposure to reviews of Information System Agreement (ISA) / Memorandum of Agreement (MOA), Whitelisting, etc.
Worked with solution engineers to identify best practices and methods required by the FedRAMP PMO to configure and operate within the NIST SP 800 series of controls.
Assist with non-cloud systems authorization efforts utilizing the Risk Management Framework (RMF).
Working knowledge of cloud architectures (e.g. SaaS, PaaS, IaaS), common commercial cloud systems (e.g. AWS, Microsoft 365, etc.) as well as specific DOD cloud architecture BCAP, ICAP, SCCA, cloud security solutions (e.g. Cloud Access Security Broker, Multi-factor Authentication, Zero Trust Architecture).
Around two (2) years of relevant Cloud Security experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems Management, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
DoDM 8140/DoDM 8570.01-M IAM Level I requirements prior to onboarding (e.g., CAP, CND, Cloud+, GSLC, Security+ CE, HCISPP or higher-level certification); willingness to obtain if not already held.
Multiple cloud certifications preferred.
Active Secret clearance required and eligibility for TS.
Must have the ability to communicate complex technical ideas clearly, both verbally and in writing, in English.

cond_0168.intro: We are looking for a FedRAMP Cloud Cybersecurity Analyst to join our team. In this role, you will work closely with program stakeholders daily to ensure the security and compliance of cloud-hosted systems. A large part of the role involves staying in regular contact with program managers, engineers, and assessment teams to keep cloud security efforts on track.
cond_0168.requirements:
Candidates should demonstrate detailed knowledge of the following:
Minimum Requirements
Prior support of FedRAMP activities for cloud-hosted systems, including eMASS Package deliverables (e.g., Readiness Assessment Report (RAR), System Security Plan (SSP), Plan of Actions & Milestones (POA&M))
Review, audit, and validate compliance of DCSA systems Secure Cloud Computing Architecture (SCCA) to ensure cloud system connections to the Boundary CAP (BCAP) and Virtual Datacenter Security Stack (VDSS) are implemented in accordance with the cloud Security Requirements Guide (SRG), including support for the internal implementation of [Product name masked] solutions
Perform periodic cybersecurity control assessments of IT cloud systems, identify potential risks and gaps, and communicate recommendations clearly to stakeholders to implement cloud security improvements based on industry standards and best practices
Perform Cyber Security Impact Assessments and Risk Assessments for new and existing cloud systems, determine security posture and viability for organizational use, and walk stakeholders through recommendations for cloud security architectures and controls
Provide support for the internal Information Security Continuous Monitoring Program for authorization to operate and ongoing authorization approvals for cloud-based IT systems
Assist Product Managers (PMs) and/or Program Management Office (PMO) with cybersecurity audits and assessments of cloud systems, including programmatic reviews and management of corrective action plans — this involves regular coordination and direct communication with PM and PMO contacts
Work with solution engineers to identify best practices and methods required by the FedRAMP PMO to configure and operate within the NIST SP 800 series of controls
Assist with non-cloud systems authorization efforts utilizing the Risk Management Framework (RMF)
Understanding and familiarity with cloud architectures (e.g., SaaS, PaaS, IaaS), common commercial cloud systems (e.g., AWS, Microsoft 365), and specific DOD cloud architecture including BCAP, ICAP, SCCA, and cloud security solutions (e.g., Cloud Access Security Broker, Multi-factor Authentication, Zero Trust Architecture)
At least two (2) years of relevant Cloud Security experience
Bachelor's Degree, or equivalent experience in Cybersecurity and/or Information Systems Management, Information Technology
DoDM 8140/DoDM 8570.01-M IAM Level I certification prior to onboarding (e.g., CAP, CND, Cloud+, GSLC, Security+ CE, HCISPP or higher)
Active Secret clearance and eligibility for TS
Must communicate complex technical ideas clearly to a diverse customer base, both verbally and in writing, in English
Reliable voice communication (cell phone preferred) and stable internet connection if working from an alternate worksite
Preferred Requirements
Experience working with Third Party Assessment Organizations (3PAO)
Participation with the DISA Cloud Joint Verification Team (JVT)
Participation in reviews of Information System Agreement (ISA) / Memorandum of Agreement (MOA), Whitelisting, etc.
Multiple cloud certifications

Proven track record supporting FedRAMP activities for cloud-hosted systems, including eMASS Package deliverables (e.g., Readiness Assessment Report (RAR), System Security Plan (SSP), Plan of Actions & Milestones (POA&M), etc.)
Deep knowledge of reviewing, auditing, and validating compliance of DCSA systems Secure Cloud Computing Architecture (SCCA) to ensure cloud system connections to the Boundary CAP (BCAP) and Virtual Datacenter Security Stack (VDSS) are implemented in accordance with the cloud Security Requirements Guide (SRG), including support for the internal implementation of the Visual Data Management System (VDMS) solutions.
Demonstrated expertise performing periodic cybersecurity control assessments of IT cloud systems, identifying potential risks and gaps, and implementing cloud security improvements based on industry standards and best practices.
Demonstrated expertise performing Cyber Security Impact Assessments and Risk Assessments for new and existing cloud systems, determining security posture and viability for organizational use, and recommending cloud security architectures and controls.
Substantial experience providing support for internal Information Security Continuous Monitoring Programs for authorization to operate and ongoing authorization approvals for cloud-based IT systems.
Proven track record working with Third Party Assessment Organizations (3PAO).
Demonstrated expertise assisting Product Managers (PMs) and/or Program Management Office (PMO) with cybersecurity audits and assessments of cloud systems, including programmatic reviews and management of corrective action plans.
Significant experience participating in reviews of Information System Agreements (ISA) / Memoranda of Agreement (MOA), Whitelisting, etc.
Demonstrated expertise working with solution engineers to identify best practices and methods required by the FedRAMP PMO to configure and operate within the NIST SP 800 series of controls.
Minimum 2 years of demonstrated expertise in Cloud Security.
Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Systems Management, or Information Technology required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
DoDM 8140/DoDM 8570.01-M IAM Level I certification required prior to onboarding (e.g., CAP, CND, Cloud+, GSLC, Security+ CE, HCISPP or higher-level certification).
Active Secret clearance required with eligibility for TS.
Exceptional communication skills — ability to convey complex technical concepts clearly to a diverse audience, both verbally and in writing in English.
Preferred Requirements
Participation with the DISA Cloud Joint Verification Team (JVT).
Proficiency in assisting with non-cloud system authorization efforts utilizing the Risk Management Framework (RMF).
Advanced knowledge of cloud architectures (e.g., SaaS, PaaS, IaaS), common commercial cloud systems (e.g., AWS, Microsoft 365), and DOD-specific cloud architecture including BCAP, ICAP, SCCA, and cloud security solutions (e.g., Cloud Access Security Broker, Multi-factor Authentication, Zero Trust Architecture).
Multiple cloud certifications.
Reliable voice communication capability (cell phone preferred) and a stable, capable internet connection if working from an alternate worksite.

A large part of the role involves staying in regular contact with program managers, engineers, and assessment teams to keep cloud security efforts on track.
cond_0348.requirements:
Candidates should demonstrate detailed knowledge of the following:
Minimum Requirements
Prior support of FedRAMP activities for cloud-hosted systems, including eMASS Package deliverables (e.g., Readiness Assessment Report (RAR), System Security Plan (SSP), Plan of Actions & Milestones (POA&M))
Review, audit, and validate compliance of DCSA systems Secure Cloud Computing Architecture (SCCA) to ensure cloud system connections to the Boundary CAP (BCAP) and Virtual Datacenter Security Stack (VDSS) are implemented in accordance with the cloud Security Requirements Guide (SRG), including support for the internal implementation of [Product name masked] solutions
Perform periodic cybersecurity control assessments of IT cloud systems, identify potential risks and gaps, and communicate recommendations clearly to stakeholders to implement cloud security improvements based on industry standards and best practices
Perform Cyber Security Impact Assessments and Risk Assessments for new and existing cloud systems, determine security posture and viability for organizational use, and walk stakeholders through recommendations for cloud security architectures and controls
Provide support for the internal Information Security Continuous Monitoring Program for authorization to operate and ongoing authorization approvals for cloud-based IT systems
Assist Product Managers (PMs) and/or Program Management Office (PMO) with cybersecurity audits and assessments of cloud systems, including programmatic reviews and management of corrective action plans — this involves regular coordination and direct communication with PM and PMO contacts
Work with solution engineers to identify best practices and methods required by the FedRAMP PMO to configure and operate within the NIST SP 800 series of controls
Assist with non-cloud systems authorization efforts utilizing the Risk Management Framework (RMF)
Understanding and familiarity with cloud architectures (e.g., SaaS, PaaS, IaaS), common commercial cloud systems (e.g., AWS, Microsoft 365), and specific DOD cloud architecture including BCAP, ICAP, SCCA, and cloud security solutions (e.g., Cloud Access Security Broker, Multi-factor Authentication, Zero Trust Architecture)
At least two (2) years of relevant Cloud Security experience
Bachelor's Degree, or equivalent experience in Cybersecurity and/or Information Systems Management, Information Technology
DoDM 8140/DoDM 8570.01-M IAM Level I certification prior to onboarding (e.g., CAP, CND, Cloud+, GSLC, Security+ CE, HCISPP or higher)
Active Secret clearance and eligibility for TS
Must communicate complex technical ideas clearly to a diverse customer base, both verbally and in writing, in English
Reliable voice communication (cell phone preferred) and stable internet connection if working from an alternate worksite
Preferred Requirements
Experience working with Third Party Assessment Organizations (3PAO)
Participation with the DISA Cloud Joint Verification Team (JVT)
Participation in reviews of Information System Agreement (ISA) / Memorandum of Agreement (MOA), Whitelisting, etc.
Multiple cloud certifications

cond_0367.intro: We are looking for a FedRAMP Cloud Security Analyst to join our team.
cond_0367.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Prior support of FedRAMP activities for cloud hosted systems such as eMASS Package (e.g., Readiness Assessment Report (RAR), System Security Plan (SSP), Plan of Actions & Milestones (POA&M), etc.)
Review, audit, and validate compliance of DCSA systems Secure Cloud Computing Architecture (SCCA) to ensure cloud system connections to the Boundary CAP (BCAP) and Virtual Datacenter Security Stack (VDSS) are implemented in accordance with the cloud Security Requirements Guide (SRG), including support for the internal implementation of the Visual Data Management System (VDMS) solutions.
Perform periodic cybersecurity control assessments of IT cloud systems, identify potential risks and gaps, and make recommendations and implement cloud security improvements based on industry standards and best practices.
Perform Cyber Security Impact Assessments and Risk Assessments for new and existing cloud systems, determine security posture and viability for organizational use, and make recommendations for cloud security architectures and controls.
Provide support for the internal Information Security Continuous Monitoring Program for authorization to operate and ongoing authorization approvals for cloud-based IT systems.
Assist Product Managers (PMs) and/or Program Management Office (PMO) with cybersecurity audits and assessments of cloud systems, including programmatic reviews and management of corrective action plans.
Work with solution engineers to identify best practices and methods required by the FedRAMP PMO to configure and operate within the NIST SP 800 series of controls.
Assist with non-cloud systems authorization efforts utilizing the Risk Management Framework (RMF).
At least two (2) years of relevant Cloud Security experience.
Bachelor's Degree, or equivalent experience in Cybersecurity, Information Systems Management, or Information Technology.
DoDM 8140/DoDM 8570.01-M IAM Level I certification prior to onboarding (e.g., CAP, CND, Cloud+, GSLC, Security+ CE, HCISPP or higher-level certification).
Active Secret clearance and eligibility for TS.
Strong written communication and clear, direct verbal reporting of complex technical ideas to a diverse customer base.
Preferred Requirements
Experience working with Third Party Assessment Organizations (3PAO).
Participation with the DISA Cloud Joint Verification Team (JVT).
Participation in reviews of Information System Agreement (ISA) / Memorandum of Agreement (MOA), Whitelisting, etc.
Understanding and familiarity with cloud architectures (e.g., SaaS, PaaS, IaaS), common commercial cloud systems (e.g., AWS, Microsoft 365, etc.), as well as specific DOD cloud architecture BCAP, ICAP, SCCA, and cloud security solutions (e.g., Cloud Access Security Broker, Multi-factor Authentication, Zero Trust Architecture).
Multiple cloud certifications.

cond_0376.intro: We are looking for a FedRAMP Cloud Cybersecurity Analyst to join our team.
cond_0376.requirements:
Candidates should demonstrate detailed knowledge of the following:
Prior support of FedRAMP activities for cloud hosted systems such as eMASS Package (ex: Readiness Assessment Report (RAR), System Security Plan (SSP), Plan of Actions & Milestones (POA&M), etc.)
Review, audit, and validate compliance of DCSA systems Secure Cloud Computing Architecture (SCCA) to ensure cloud systems connections to the Boundary CAP (BCAP) and Virtual Datacenter Security Stack (VDSS) are implemented in accordance with the cloud Security Requirements Guide (SRG), including support for the internal implementation of the Visual Data Management System (VDMS) solutions internally.
Perform periodic cyber security control assessments of IT cloud systems, identify potential risks and gaps, and make recommendations and implement cloud security improvements based on industry standards and best practices.
Perform Cyber Security Impact Assessments and Risk Assessments for new and existing cloud systems, determine security posture and viability for organizational use, and make recommendations for cloud security architectures and controls.
Provide support for the internal Information Security Continuous Monitoring Program for authorization to operate and ongoing authorization approvals for cloud-based IT systems.
Experience working with Third Party Assessment Organizations (3PAO).
Participation with the DISA Cloud Joint Verification Team (JVT).
Coordinate with Product Managers (PMs) and/or Program Management Office (PMO) on cyber security audits and assessments of cloud systems, including programmatic reviews and management of corrective action plans.
Participated in reviews of Information System Agreement (ISA) / Memorandum of Agreement (MOA), Whitelisting, etc.
Worked with solution engineers to identify best practices and methods required by the FedRAMP PMO to configure and operate within the NIST SP 800 series of controls.
Assist with non-cloud systems authorization efforts utilizing the Risk Management Framework (RMF).
Understanding and familiarity with cloud architectures (e.g. SaaS, PaaS, IaaS), common commercial cloud systems (e.g. AWS, Microsoft 365, etc.) as well as specific DOD cloud architecture BCAP, ICAP, SCCA, cloud security solutions (e.g. Cloud Access Security Broker, Multi-factor Authentication, Zero Trust Architecture).
At least two (2) years relevant Cloud Security experience.
Bachelor's Degree, or equivalent experience in Cybersecurity, and/or Information Systems Management, Information Technology.
DoDM 8140/DoDM 8570.01-M IAM Level I requirements prior to onboarding e.g., CAP, CND, Cloud+, GSLC, Security+ CE, HCISPP or higher-level certification.
Multiple cloud certifications preferred.
Active Secret Required and eligibility for TS.
Must have reliable ability to communicate over voice (cell phone preferred) and a stable, capable internet connection if working from an alternate worksite.
Must be able to communicate complex technical ideas clearly, both verbally and in written form.

Prior support of FedRAMP activities for cloud hosted systems such as eMASS Package (ex: Readiness Assessment Report (RAR), System Security Plan (SSP), Plan of actions & Milestones (POA&M), etc.)
Review, Audit, and validate compliance of DCSA systems Secure Cloud Computing Architecture (SCCA) to ensure cloud systems connections to the Boundary CAP (BCAP) and Virtual Datacenter Security Stack (VDSS) are implemented in accordance with the cloud Security Requirements Guide (SRG) including support for the internal implementation of the Visual Data Management System (VDMS) solutions internally.
Perform periodic cyber security control assessments of IT cloud systems, identify potential risks and gaps, and make recommendations and implement cloud security improvements based on industry standards and best practices.
Perform Cyber Security Impact Assessments and Risk Assessments for new and existing cloud systems, determine security posture and viability for organizational use, and make recommendations for cloud security architectures and controls.
Provide support for the internal Information Security Continuous Monitoring Program for authorization to operate and ongoing authorization approvals for cloud-based IT systems.
Experience working with Third Party Assessment Organizations (3PAO).
Participation with the DISA Cloud Joint Verification Team (JVT) Team.
Assist the Product Managers (PMs) and/or Program Management Office (PMO) with cyber security audits and assessments of cloud systems including programmatic reviews and management of corrective action plans.
Participated in reviews of Information System Agreement (ISA) / Memorandum of Agreement (MOA), Whitelisting, etc.
Worked with the solution engineers to identify best practices and methods required by the FedRAMP PMO to configure and operate within the NIST SP 800 series of controls.
Assist with non-cloud systems authorization efforts utilizing the Risk Management Framework (RMF).
Understanding and familiarity with cloud architectures (e.g. SaaS, PaaS, IaaS), common commercial cloud systems (e.g. AWS, Microsoft 365, etc.) as well as specific DOD cloud architecture BCAP, ICAP, SCCA, cloud security solutions (e.g. Cloud Access Security Broker, Multi-factor Authentication, Zero Trust Architecture).
At least two (2) years relevant Cloud Security experience.
Bachelor's Degree, or equivalent experience in Cybersecurity, and/or Information Systems Management, Information Technology.
DoDM 8140/DoDM 8570.01-M IAM Level I requirements prior to onboarding e.g., CAP, CND, Cloud+, GSLC, Security+ CE, HCISPP or higher-level certification.
Multiple cloud certifications preferred.
Active Secret Required and eligibility for TS.
Must speak English well enough to communicate complex technical ideas to a diverse customer both verbally and in written form.

In this role, you will work closely with program stakeholders daily to ensure the security and compliance of cloud-hosted systems. A large part of the role involves staying in regular contact with program managers, engineers, and assessment teams to keep cloud security efforts on track.
cond_0492.requirements:
Candidates should demonstrate detailed knowledge of the following:
Minimum Requirements
Prior support of FedRAMP activities for cloud-hosted systems, including eMASS Package deliverables (e.g., Readiness Assessment Report (RAR), System Security Plan (SSP), Plan of Actions & Milestones (POA&M))
Review, audit, and validate compliance of DCSA systems Secure Cloud Computing Architecture (SCCA) to ensure cloud system connections to the Boundary CAP (BCAP) and Virtual Datacenter Security Stack (VDSS) are implemented in accordance with the cloud Security Requirements Guide (SRG), including support for the internal implementation of [Product name masked] solutions
Perform periodic cybersecurity control assessments of IT cloud systems, identify potential risks and gaps, and communicate recommendations clearly to stakeholders to implement cloud security improvements based on industry standards and best practices
Perform Cyber Security Impact Assessments and Risk Assessments for new and existing cloud systems, determine security posture and viability for organizational use, and walk stakeholders through recommendations for cloud security architectures and controls
Provide support for the internal Information Security Continuous Monitoring Program for authorization to operate and ongoing authorization approvals for cloud-based IT systems
Assist Product Managers (PMs) and/or Program Management Office (PMO) with cybersecurity audits and assessments of cloud systems, including programmatic reviews and management of corrective action plans — this involves regular coordination and direct communication with PM and PMO contacts
Work with solution engineers to identify best practices and methods required by the FedRAMP PMO to configure and operate within the NIST SP 800 series of controls
Assist with non-cloud systems authorization efforts utilizing the Risk Management Framework (RMF)
Understanding and familiarity with cloud architectures (e.g., SaaS, PaaS, IaaS), common commercial cloud systems (e.g., AWS, Microsoft 365), and specific DOD cloud architecture including BCAP, ICAP, SCCA, and cloud security solutions (e.g., Cloud Access Security Broker, Multi-factor Authentication, Zero Trust Architecture)
At least two (2) years of relevant Cloud Security experience
Bachelor's Degree, or equivalent experience in Cybersecurity and/or Information Systems Management, Information Technology
DoDM 8140/DoDM 8570.01-M IAM Level I certification prior to onboarding (e.g., CAP, CND, Cloud+, GSLC, Security+ CE, HCISPP or higher)
Active Secret clearance and eligibility for TS
Must communicate complex technical ideas clearly to a diverse customer base, both verbally and in writing, in English
Reliable voice communication (cell phone preferred) and stable internet connection if working from an alternate worksite
Preferred Requirements
Experience working with Third Party Assessment Organizations (3PAO)
Participation with the DISA Cloud Joint Verification Team (JVT)
Participation in reviews of Information System Agreement (ISA) / Memorandum of Agreement (MOA), Whitelisting, etc.
Multiple cloud certifications

Prior support of FedRAMP activities for cloud hosted systems such as eMASS Package (ex: Readiness Assessment Report (RAR), System Security Plan (SSP), Plan of actions & Milestones (POA&M), etc.)
Review, Audit, and validate compliance of DCSA systems Secure Cloud Computing Architecture (SCCA) to ensure cloud systems connections to the Boundary CAP (BCAP) and Virtual Datacenter Security Stack (VDSS) are implemented in accordance with the cloud Security Requirements Guide (SRG) including support for the internal implementation of the Visual Data Management System (VDMS) solutions internally.
Perform periodic cyber security control assessments of IT cloud systems, identify potential risks and gaps, and make recommendations and implement cloud security improvements based on industry standards and best practices.
Perform Cyber Security Impact Assessments and Risk Assessments for new and existing cloud systems, determine security posture and viability for organizational use, and make recommendations for cloud security architectures and controls.
Provide support for the internal Information Security Continuous Monitoring Program for authorization to operate and ongoing authorization approvals for cloud-based IT systems.
Experience working with Third Party Assessment Organizations (3PAO).
Participation with the DISA Cloud Joint Verification Team (JVT) Team.
Assist the Product Managers (PMs) and/or Program Management Office (PMO) with cyber security audits and assessments of cloud systems including programmatic reviews and management of corrective action plans.
Participated in reviews of Information System Agreement (ISA) / Memorandum of Agreement (MOA), Whitelisting, etc.
Worked with the solution engineers to identify best practices and methods required by the FedRAMP PMO to configure and operate within the NIST SP 800 series of controls.
Assist with non-cloud systems authorization efforts utilizing the Risk Management Framework (RMF).
Understanding and familiarity with cloud architectures (e.g. SaaS, PaaS, IaaS), common commercial cloud systems (e.g. AWS, Microsoft 365, etc.) as well as specific DOD cloud architecture BCAP, ICAP, SCCA, cloud security solutions (e.g. Cloud Access Security Broker, Multi-factor Authentication, Zero Trust Architecture).
At least two (2) years relevant Cloud Security experience.
Bachelor's Degree, or equivalent experience in Cybersecurity, and/or Information Systems Management, Information Technology.
DoDM 8140/DoDM 8570.01-M IAM Level I requirements prior to onboarding e.g., CAP, CND, Cloud+, GSLC, Security+ CE, HCISPP or higher-level certification.
Multiple cloud certifications preferred.
Active Secret Required and eligibility for TS.
Must have the reliable ability to communicate over voice (cell phone preferred) and stable, capable internet connection.
Must speak English well enough to communicate complex technical ideas to a diverse customer both verbally and in written form.
